- memory_id "1000855": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade, and since it is not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000750": As of 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)

- memory_id "1000768": On 2025-11-03, the Boreal team reported that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)

- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000851": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000827" [decision]: As of 2025-11-26, the Atlas team owns the image resizer, having taken it over from the Ember team.  (about: Atlas team, Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000909" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000818" [decision]: As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the event bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000703": As of 2025-09-23, the Dune team noticed that the bus's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000615": As of 2025-09-02, feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of them were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000721": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000690": The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs, which prompted the reporting service to switch from the ledger service to the bus.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
